messages.subject: Particulars of Claim - draft for your mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Draft Particulars of Claim attached for your review (v1). I've pleaded the four POs, the implied terms, the Wraysbury findings and the heads of loss as per the LBA. Two things to decide before we issue: (1) whether to net the Wexbourne loss of profit down for the replacement business now or leave it to the schedule; (2) whether to add a short paragraph meeting the stockholder point.

Elena

messages.plaintextBody:
Elena - both, please. Net the Wexbourne figure to 710k (credit for the replacement business) and bring the total down to 1,767,400 accordingly; and add a paragraph that the stockholder/reliance-on-mill point is no answer to us. I've marked these up in v2 (redline attached). Once you've taken those in we can finalise and issue before the holidays.

Tom Gallagher
